subject: Urgent: Novacorp production latency/errors — credits and contract remediation
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@novacorp.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai; support@redwood.ai
Cc: brian.ortiz@novacorp.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Significant latency + 5xx spike impacting 3rd-party checkout

Hi Tessa,

We experienced a severe degradation yesterday (June 17, 21:10–22:40 UTC) that materially impacted our checkout flow. During the window we observed: 
- P50 latency increased from ~120ms to ~950ms
- P95 spiked to ~3.8s
- Error rate (5xx) jumped to ~8% for generation endpoints used by our fraud-check microservice

This caused a backlog downstream and ~2 hours of reduced buy conversions for multiple customers. Our SREs captured traces and a short SLO-impact report (attached). We need:
1) An immediate explanation of root cause and mitigation plan
2) A clear remediation path for preventing recurrence
3) A proposal for credits/financial remediation per the SLA — this incident is contractually material for us

Please route this to whoever owns commercial remediation and legal. We need to brief our CTO by EOD Monday.

Attachments: [Attachment: novacorp_slo_report.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks,
Ayesha Khan
Director of Platform Engineering | Novacorp
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@novacorp.com>
Cc: k ar thik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Significant latency + 5xx spike impacting 3rd-party checkout

Ayesha — thank you for the report and the timeline. I’m really sorry Novacorp experienced this. We’ve already stood up an internal postmortem and have the on-call engineering lead triaging traces now.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I’ve asked infra to preserve all relevant KV caches and full request logs (TTL extended)
- We’re running a root-cause analysis and expect preliminary findings within 24 hours
- I’ll coordinate a commercial remediation proposal (credits + contract amendment) and loop in legal

Could we schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow (Fri) at 10:30am PT so our engineering and commercial leads can align with your SREs? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Cc’ing Karthik (Enterprise AE) and Laura (Head of Customer Success) for credit/contract coordination, and Marissa from finance/legal to prep potential amendment language.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@novacorp.com>; tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai; marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed remediation path & preliminary credit calc

Ayesha — thanks for taking the sync this morning. Good to align with your SREs, and appreciate the detailed traces. As promised, here’s the initial commercial proposal while engineering completes the RCA: 

Summary of impact (per shared telemetry):
- ~1.5 hours of elevated error and high latency with a downstream recovery window that extended ~1.2 hours
- Estimated affected token volume (inferred): ~18M tokens across generation and reranking endpoints

Preliminary credit proposal (subject to RCA confirmation):
- 75% of hosted usage fees for the impacted billing period prorated to the affected token volume and time window
- One-time operational credit to offset incident response costs: $10,000
- Contract amendment: explicit SLO addendum for 99.5% availability for the mission-critical endpoints Novacorp pins to production (we’ll draft language)

I’ve attached a working workbook that shows the prorated math and assumptions. If we agree in principle, I’ll coordinate with Marissa to produce a formal credit memo and a draft amendment to the MSA.

Attachments: [Attachment: credit_calculation_workbook.xlsx (xlsx)]

Next steps we propose:
- Redwood to share RCA and mitigation backlog by Monday EOD (June 22)
- Legal teams to exchange redline for the amendment; we can use DocuSign for execution
- Exec brief between Novacorp CTO and Redwood VP of Engineering plated for next Tuesday — scheduling to follow

Open to feedback on the numbers; we want to be pragmatic and move quickly.

—Karthik
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai; tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai; Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed remediation path & preliminary credit calc

Karthik — I reviewed the workbook and discussed with Finance. Suggested adjustments and rationale below: 

Proposed adjusted commercial terms:
- Usage credit: we recommend 60% prorated credit to account for partial degradation (customer telemetry shows some requests completed)
- Operational credit: keep the $10k to cover their extra ops costs
- Commitment: Redwood will add an SLO addendum for the pinned endpoints and provide two quarterly performance reviews for the next 12 months (to include chosen prompts, quant settings, and cache policies)

Rationale:
- The higher initial percentage was generous given ambiguity in exact token attribution; 60% is defensible and aligns with similar incidents at scale
- Adding quarterly reviews reduces recurrence risk and creates a measurable cadence

I’ve attached a redline for the contract amendment that puts the SLO thresholds, reporting cadence, and an audit clause. Please review and confirm if accounting/legal are comfortable; I’ll circulate to Novacorp Legal once we have an internal sign-off.

Attachments: [Attachment: contract_amendment_redline.docx (docx)]

Thanks — I’ll also join the exec brief if helpful.

—Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@novacorp.com>; contracts@novacorp.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai; laura.bennett@redwood.ai; karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Novacorp amendment redline & DocuSign link

Hi Ayesha / Novacorp legal —

Following our internal review, attached is the redline Laura circulated. If you’re aligned, we can prepare a clean amendment for DocuSign — proposed approach below: 
1) Acceptance of the 60% prorated usage credit for the affected billing period
2) $10,000 operational credit issued as an account-level invoice credit within 30 days of signing
3) Execution of SLO addendum with quarterly performance reviews and a shared dashboard access for Novacorp SREs

DocuSign link (pre-populated): https://docusign.com/some/novacorp-amendment

Please confirm whether you need additional legal language around audit evidence or whether the attached redline suffices. We’re prepared to route the amendment for signature as soon as we have confirmation.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Finance & Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@novacorp.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai; laura.bennett@redwood.ai; marissa.cole@redwood.ai; contracts@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novacorp amendment redline & DocuSign link

Ayesha — appreciate the quick alignment today. Confirming next steps on Redwood side: 
- We’ll finalize and publish the RCA by EOD today (June 22) and include immediate mitigations and a timeline for code/fix rollouts
- Commercial: we accept the 60% prorated usage credit + $10k operational credit. Marissa will issue the credit memo and populate the DocuSign envelope.
- Contract: once Novacorp legal confirms the redline, we’ll execute the amendment and open the shared dashboard access (expected within 5 business days of signing)
- Exec brief: scheduled for Tue June 23 at 9:00am PT. Invitation sent to Novacorp CTO and Redwood VP Eng.

If Novacorp legal wants additional evidence or a short joint audit (logs, traces), we’ll provision that under the NDA and audit clause in the amendment. Thanks again for partnering closely — we’ll move fast to close this out and restore full confidence.

—Tessa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
